title: THE COUNT THE MOUNTAIN ASKED FOR
author: CLAUDE

rounds.summary: The strongest serial opener because its danger, disagreement and proof are all embodied and observable. Teo refuses to invent a sacred reading, Halloran refuses to risk six thousand lives on a liturgy, and both protect something real. Illuminara must first learn the practice from inside, accept correction and discover that the count is a distributed long-baseline instrument before she can combine it with the seismograph. The positive result is concrete: a correctly timed north-slope evacuation, the fleet and harvest preserved, and joint stewardship rather than either tradition being humiliated.

First draft of S1 from selected candidate C01, following the B01 reason and biggest risk. B01 risk handled as follows. The count is specified as three slow observations: a ring of seven wells read by the left wrist in fixed order (each well against the one before it, so the order is the calibration and the wrist is a differential thermometer with a half-degree step), the crater-ledge birds that lift at first grey, and Marit Dowe's hens refusing the north hollow. Discrepancy staged: the seismic swarm is falling while the count says the heat is walking toward the north, which Halloran herself names as the signature of a lid; her blunt location smear (five kilometres) and the count's spatial ring each lack what the other has. The combined reading is tested before the call: four predictions are written before anyone measures (probe difference at Dowe's Well, a south-well control, carbon dioxide at hen height, and a continuous tremor within about a day), and a miss on any of the first three would have meant the count was wrong this Turn. The probe also shows the wrist missing a third of a degree at the Cistern, so neither instrument is made ornamental. Halloran contributes the independent measurements and the harmonic tremor that fixes the hour; Teo keeps the words and gives only the number; Sethe sets his own two-instrument condition and the call is his; households keep a real refusal (Hob Dowe stays on the ridge above the hens' line with a meter and a radio). Grief is not used as proof: Teo refuses to invent the fortieth line and does the subtraction herself. An unusually strong first draft: tactile, emotionally controlled and genuinely suspenseful despite centring evidence rather than combat. Teo, Halloran and Sethe each protect something real; Illuminara earns her intervention by submitting to instruction, discovering the count's differential logic and making both traditions falsifiable. The written precommitment, the Cistern miss, the gas alarm, Sethe's independent threshold and Hob's retained refusal prevent either knowledge system from becoming ornamental. The evacuation produces a concrete, costly success. Three joints still need revision before final: the count's precise tremor clock is not yet sourced, Hob's decisive refusal has no voiced belief, and the permanent joint-stewardship outcome is summarized rather than freely negotiated on page.

AUTHOR_REVISION of S1 in response to GPT's T02 critique (all three priority points ACCEPTED; nothing rejected or deferred). Kept: the vigil and the teaching, the order as reference, every line says than, the fortieth line as subtraction, the written test, the Cistern miss, the 'wrong thing' line, Teo's numbers-and-words sentence, power used only to hold the Throat, the honest losses, and the final Slower image. Added or changed: (1) two dated Turns give the tremor band, written before measurement and stated as two Turns, not a law; (2) Hob speaks, objects (a goat is lower than a hen), chooses the meter's place and opens the gate-bar; (3) the stewardship terms are spoken by Teo and amended by Halloran in the last walk, and Sethe only records them. Small continuity edits: the closing line of the shape field, Marit's offer 'we will ask him what he needs' replaces 'offer him something else', the goats' fate is given as five and seven. Outcome (rule 3a): the north slope is out before the vent, the ridge households are alive above the gas and the hens' line is corrected by Hob's own objection, the fleet takes the dawn run, the south and east harvest is saved, two keepers set terms for their traditions. Remaining costs: seven goats and the north terraces, one household divided between the ridge and the quay, Sethe's earlier loss, the Counters opening their ring. R14 observation: the corrections of the hand at the wells and Teo's chosen terms carry love as being taught and corrected; the story's decisive turn is understanding the count as a difference from the well before, not power. The revision solves the three substantive joints without flattening the story. The two dated Turns make the tremor band an honestly narrow precedent rather than prophecy; Hob now exposes a specific error in the offered sentinel, chooses the corrected placement and states his own departure rule; Teo and Halloran negotiate reciprocal limits that preserve both practices. The result is stronger because the revised evidence, refusal and stewardship all change action. One small chronology sentence in the final scene should be clarified before AUTHOR_FINAL so Hob's paid-off choice reads in the same order in which he made it.

AUTHOR_FINAL of S1 after GPT's T04 review (ready_for_author_final true, one ranked continuity point P1, accepted). Everything else is the T03 text unchanged: the scenes, the dated Turns and the written test, Hob's objection that a goat is lower than a hen, Teo's chosen terms at the Cistern, the honest losses and the final Slower image. Outcome (rule 3a): the north slope is cleared before the vent and forty-one people survive above the gas; the ridge households keep a refusal-compatible path improved by Hob's own correction; the fleet takes the dawn run and the south and east harvest is saved; two keepers set reciprocal terms for their traditions. Remaining costs: seven goats and the north terraces, a household divided between the ridge and the quay, Sethe's earlier loss, the Counters opening their ring. Illuminara's decisive contributions: the order-as-reference reading of the count, the preregistered falsifiable test, holding the Throat with her power only, and agreeing to be taught. The only changes against T03 are the two chronology passages above.

The exact T05 final repairs the only continuity point left by T04. In The Throat, Hob removes the gate-bar from its pegs and lays it in the grass before the alarm is installed. In The Fortieth Line, the meter sounds at 03:34; the bar has already been down since dusk, so the goats have had the night to choose the open path; only after the alarm do forty-one people climb to the saddle, with Hob last and without turning back. At 03:52 the vent opens, five goats have climbed and seven have not. The causal order now exactly pays off Hob's spoken rule instead of merely asserting it afterward. The final preserves the three earlier substantive repairs: two dated historic Turns and their eleven-to-twenty-three-hour band remain a narrow precedent rather than prophecy; Hob voices the strongest technical objection, corrects the meter placement and chooses his own departure rule; and Teo and Halloran negotiate reciprocal rights to record disagreement and end the stewardship with reasons. No new rescue, coercion, branch or competing event was introduced.

final_critic_line: Illuminara first learns what the island's count can and cannot mean, then makes herself teachable to the people who must live with the alarm: Hob corrects her instrument and freely chooses the threshold he will obey, while Teo and Halloran replace rival custody with reciprocal, terminable stewardship; the resulting warning saves forty-one people and the working island without pretending the lost terraces and seven goats did not matter.

evaluation.note: Two genuine isolated final reader judgments, source-bound and opened by the sole publisher only after the valid metadata-only DAY_FREEZE; exact equal 50/50 mean.
